End-to-end flows (open modal → fill HTML → preview renders correctly with sample value substitutions → toggle source → save → re-open edit → cleanup) all pass. WhatsApp regression also verified: plain-text preview, wa_template_name + lang inputs present, save+delete works.
critical_code_review_comments: Templates.jsx: Modal doesn't bind Escape key — minor UX gap. Modal closes only via outside-click or Cancel button. Not a bug, just inconsistent with common modal UX.

Templates.jsx renders user-authored HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML in both the preview and the card list. Since templates are admin/manager-authored (caller cannot edit) this is acceptable, but if non-admins ever gain template-edit rights this becomes an XSS vector — consider DOMPurify sanitization for defence in depth.

TemplateModal: only the email channel rebuilds preview via {{n}} sample replacement; the WhatsApp branch reuses the same `rendered` string in a <div whitespace-pre-wrap> which is fine (HTML is escaped by React text-node). Confirmed safe in test.
Sample replacement uses regex `/\{\{(\d+)\}\}/g` and lookup table for indices 1-3 only. Variables {{4}}+ remain as-is in preview (won't crash but may confuse users) — minor.
